messages:
matt: Heads-up — country-slice rollout of v2.1.3 starts in 2h. plan: stagger by region (EU -> APAC -> NA). keeping a tight quiet window for 30m after each slice.
sara: ack. EU prewarm done, canary looks clean. logs: 200/200 success on smoke. :party:
deploy-bot: [automated] pin applied: v2.1.3 -> service/embedding (pin-id: pin-9843).
kyle: quick checklist: 1) release notes posted, 2) monitoring dashboards up, 3) rollback owners assigned. I pushed RN to /docs/releases/2.1.3.md
anita: rollback owners = @kyle + @matt. rollback plan: revert traffic to v2.1.2 and drain cache, ETA ~6m. make sure migration flag disabled: `FEATURE_EMBED_V2=false`.
matt: @sara can you hold on unpin for EU until we clear the 30m quiet period?
sara: yes, will not unpin until smoke+30m.
deploy-bot: smoke check (EU) passed. metrics: latency p95 120ms, error rate 0.2%.
 kyle: re: docs — included migration notes and compatibility caveats. small snippet for ops: ```bash
/deploy rollback service/embedding v2.1.2 --drain
```
anita: If we see embedding regression >5% on quality evals, we cut traffic immediately. who’s owning eval alerts? @oncall-bot should route to the channel and call pager at threshold.
oncall-bot: [automated] alert routing set: embeddings-regression -> pagers: @oncall, escalation 5m.
matt: ok EU slice looks stable at +30m. @sara go ahead to unpin and open NA warmup.
sara: unpinning now: /deploy unpin service/embedding pin-9843
deploy-bot: [automated] unpin complete for service/embedding (pin-9843). NA warmup requested.
kyle: NA warmup logs look good, starting NA canary (5% traffic)
anita: reminder: keep canary to max 12m, if any surge in cost or latency spike >20% rollback.
matt: final note — release notes include known issue: rare tokenization diff on long prompts. we have hotfix branch ready if needed.
sara: NA canary steady at 10m, metrics stable. proceeding to full NA after 12m. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: canary -> promoted to full for NA. traffic shift initiated.
anita: rolling back EU if we see cross-slice regressions. be ready.
matt: go/no-go for APAC in 30m. will reconvene T-10m in this thread. thanks all.
